note: These overrides correct cases where page-wide phrase matching loses record or date context. They remain needs-human-review and must not be represented as manual approval.

decisions.rationale: The cited 2026 application window closed on 10 July 2026.
The official Batch 23 page says applications are open from 20 July through 21 August 2026.
The official page provides current application paths for the Founders and Portfolio packages; an invite-only higher tier does not make the whole program limited.
The matched invite-only text describes a dashboard permission, not availability of Datadog preview features.
Current visitor fellowship routes accept applications throughout the year; capacity language does not mean the whole visitor programme is limited.
The official page says in-person applications ended and remote ticket grant applications are closed.
The 2026 cohort has completed and the current accelerator page offers an interest form rather than an open application.
Current program terms describe signup and review; the invite-only phrase on the original FAQ refers to a partner conference.
The official application page is for the 2024 cohort and states that applications closed on 5 March 2024.
The live directory contains public programs; only one of several participation modes is invite-only.
The stored source is a stale 2015 application page, while the provider has already announced the selected 2026 fellows.
The page says applications were open through 10 February 2026, a date that has passed.
The provider currently accepts expressions of interest and says applicants will be notified when the next application window opens.
The provider page gave 10 July 2026 as the extended Fall 2026 application deadline, which has passed.
Slack's current instructions allow users to opt into the desktop beta; unrelated invite-only workspace text caused the automatic match.
The official fund page says it is not accepting applications and lists 15 June 2026 as the last deadline.
